name: motif_count
author: e1e14ad1
description: Counts small 3-node patterns in a graph. Use for 'how many triangles are there?', 'are there feed-forward loops?', 'which small patterns are most common?' and 'which nodes are in the most triangles?'. Works on directed and undirected graphs; weights and self-loops are ignored. Returns triangles (any three nodes linked pairwise, direction ignored; includes feed-forward loops and cycles), open_triads (exactly two of three pairs linked), feed_forward_loops (A->B, B->C, A->C) and directed_cycles (A->B, B->C, C->A), which are null on undirected graphs, and top_nodes (the top_k nodes in the most triangles, each with its triangles count). Loops and cycles are induced: exactly those three one-way edges, so on airports only 1 triple is a feed-forward loop. Not for per-node clustering (clustering_coefficient) or edge counts and density (graph_summary).

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many top nodes to list, ranked by how many triangles they are in (default 10, maximum 100). The counts are never truncated.
